limitations: Item rollback apply remains disabled; commands do not acquire reservations.
Detached/off-thread containers, direct getItems/setItems and mutable stack/list/component writes, arbitrary overrides and bypassing loader capabilities remain pending.
The owner whitelist is unchanged; tests cover eight existing supported block inventories.
Direct writes conservatively revoke all reservations before continuing; unrelated hopper writes can cancel coordination.
Ordinary read checks use inventories without pending loot. Reads that unpack loot are not fully certified.
Synthetic reservations and actual container methods are exercised; no connected-client or modpack acceptance is claimed.
These hooks do not add direct-command mutation history or prove completed world/player saves.
fixtureNotes: Private reflection-only agent opens modules without replacing Minecraft bytecode. No synthetic players are inserted into the world.
Each loader passed 82 checks with logging disabled and enabled.
An initial Fabric run caught hopper overrides bypassing shared slot methods; explicit hopper guards repaired that gap before the final full matrix.
Eight isolated fixtures: barrel, chest, hopper, dispenser, dropper, furnace, blast furnace and smoker.
Loot-table setters tested clearing loaded loot metadata without unpacking or generating loot.
Temporary blocks and chunk tickets removed; original configs restored. Normal audit/journal tables preserved.
Both servers stopped with alpha.30 installed and matching optional Fabric WorldEdit adapter.
Private instructions, tooling, agents, databases and logs excluded from Git and source archive.
